customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be of good quality, with positive feedback about its taste, installation process, and ease of use. The water quality receives positive reviews, with one customer noting a substantial improvement in filtration quality. However, durability is a concern, with multiple customers reporting damage to filters within 6 months of use. Additionally, reliability and value for money receive mixed reviews, with some finding it excellent while others say it's not worth the investment.

reviews.author: Anu
reviews.title: Defective Unit! Broke down 5 times in 6 months. Terrible Service.
reviews.body: Do not buy this product. I purchased the Kent Supreme less than a year ago, and it has already failed 5times in the first 6 months. Major components like the SMPS and Carbon Filter have already been replaced. ​Now, the machine is dispensing foul, bad-smelling water. The service team is completely uncoordinated—one day support tells me to pay ₹500 for a Post-Carbon filter, and the next day a technician visits and says the UV membrane is broken which is cost min 1100.
